composition.title: Pauli's egg dream — spontaneous division, conscious participation and the circle

scenes.title: A physicist meets his concepts in a dream
Pictures 1–2: the egg laid; the egg divides itself
Pictures 3–4: the egg in his own hand; division that keeps wholeness
Pictures 5–6: four eggs become expressions; the conjugate quotient
Picture 7: he speaks, and the circle appears
Pauli reads the part played by consciousness
Return: the recovered telling and its authorial office

expression:return-of-zero:roz-mytheme-pa.title: the dreamer — Pauli, after the Kepler work, mid-March 1948
background physics — concepts arriving unbidden
the companion dream — Göttingen; the hydrogen ground state; brass tones on a metal plate
Fierz's note — an undated typescript, an outline not a finished publication
the woman with the bird — unnamed; their action brings the egg
picture 1 — the single egg, awaiting what will happen
picture 2 — the egg divides itself
no good egg and evil egg — no conflict between them
pictures 1–2 — the spontaneous pair above
picture 3 — the blue-shelled egg in his hand
picture 4 — divided, both whole
the marvel — two eggs, not two broken portions
the dreamer — approaches, notices, participates
picture 5 — four expressions, two rows: cos(δ/2) sin(δ/2) / cos(δ/2) sin(δ/2)
picture 6 — the quotient [cos+i·sin]/[cos−i·sin], modulus one in the denominator
no shell-to-function assignment is added
the opposing signs retained in one relation
formula → circle
the spoken recognition — the dreamer's first speech
the unit circle — a point for fixed angle, the circle as the angle varies
no eighth scene — no return of the woman and bird
the ground state — the spontaneous pair
conscious intervention — noticing and dividing what he already holds
the imaginary unit's symbolic office — opposites combined into the form read as wholeness
the refusal — further progress in the sciences would be required
Neumann's round compared — no egg-to-stage assignment
the circle — the dream's end, exact in its own scope
the four eggs with two different origins — retained
X/x is Taylor's — seven pictures and four eggs count no eightfold identity
A19 comparison — the observer brought into the operation he first receives as scene
